title: Design QA 101
subtitle: This guide highlights Design Quality Assurance (DQA) as a vital role in Agile projects, covering Jira integration, design tokens, baselines, automated testing and emerging trends.

entries.title: Introduction
entries.description: Why design QA matters, and how baselines set the standard the rest of the work is measured against.

entries.title: Quality Assurance Activities Overview
entries.description: The team roles, touchpoints, and activities that make DQA a shared practice rather than a final gate.

entries.title: Accelerator Tools for Streamlining DQA
entries.description: The tools that remove friction from design QA so review time goes to judgment, not setup.

entries.title: Usability and User Experience Testing
entries.description: Evaluating usability and UX, and folding user feedback back into the design as it iterates.
